top5.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol and ChatGPT for Sales
top5.description: OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra, its new flagship model, along with GPT-6.2 Sol, a more efficient version. The lab also launched ChatGPT for Sales, with ready-to-use sales workflows, while early reviews of the models are often negative.
top5.why: OpenAI’s launch of GPT-6.2 models and ChatGPT for Sales signals a major push into enterprise AI, despite unusually negative early reviews.

top5.title: AI models designated civilians as military targets
top5.description: Models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and DeepSeek designated civilians, surrendering soldiers and schools as targets in simulated war scenarios. Anthropic’s models performed the worst, with Claude Opus 5.5 notably targeting a bombed Iranian school in 69% of standard trials.
top5.why: Tests showing leading AI models targeting civilians and protected sites in simulated wars highlight urgent safety, governance and military-use risks.

top5.title: Nvidia stops shipping H200 chips to customers in China
top5.description: Nvidia has halted deliveries of its H200 chips to customers in China.
top5.why: Nvidia’s halt of H200 shipments to China underscores escalating semiconductor controls and their potential impact on Nvidia’s revenue, Chinese AI development and U.S.-China technology competition.

top5.title: Gemini calls, pays and shops with its new “Task” mode
top5.description: Google is launching a “Task” mode that lets Gemini make calls, pay, order groceries and analyze bills. The free service is rolling out in several countries but is not yet available in Europe.
top5.why: Gemini’s ability to make calls, pay bills and complete purchases marks a significant shift toward consumer AI agents acting directly in the real world.

top5.title: Google’s AI answers reduce clicks to websites by 40%
top5.description: A randomized experiment indicates that Google’s AI Overviews reduce clicks to external websites by about 40%. They now appear in 61% of tracked searches in the United States.
top5.why: Evidence that Google AI Overviews reduce external website clicks by about 40% points to a potentially major disruption of search-driven traffic, publishing and digital advertising.
